versions.changelog:
Initial release of diy-pc-master: a skill for generating custom PC build recommendations and compatibility analysis.

- Provides guided process: user intent analysis, SQL build config generation, API part selection, and compatibility checking.
- Supports scenario detection for DIY配置推荐/分析 and 配置测评.
- Generates SQL queries for PC parts based on user budget and application, ensuring prices match budget allocation rules.
- Fetches real-time parts info and purchase links from DIYZP.cn via API.
- Assembles a full, compatible build sheet with 京东购买链接 for each component.
- Outputs compatibility notes and summary suggestions; adds a data source disclaimer.
